affinity.description: Affinity rules for the operator pod.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full resource name prefix.

digest.description: Image digest. Takes precedence over tag when set, for example `sha256:abc...`.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries.

leaderElect.description: Enable leader election so that only one replica reconciles at a time.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the operator pod.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the operator pod.

replicaCount.description: Number of operator replicas. Leader election makes only one of them active.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the operator container.

mode.description: Operator scope. `cluster` watches all namespaces via ClusterRole. `namespace` confines workload access to a single namespace via Role. CrashLoopPolicy itself is cluster-scoped either way, so policy access is always granted through a ClusterRole.

watchNamespace.description: Namespace to watch when mode is `namespace`. Defaults to the release namespace when empty.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount.

create.description: Create a ServiceAccount for the operator.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. Generated from the release name when empty.
